boo1.text: Oyen..? This isn't the Kitty Town. Where are we?

boo2.speaker: Oyen
boo2.text: ...I think that might have to wait for a bit, Kitty... There is something I need you to see.

boo2.speaker: Kitty
boo2.text: What is happening???? Is this a joke?

boo3.speaker: Oyen
boo3.text: I'm sorry, but it's not a joke.

boo5.speaker: Oyen
boo5.text: Remember crossing that log in the forest?

boo6.speaker: Oyen
boo6.text: You... Didn't just slip and faint.....

boo8.speaker: Kitty
boo8.text: But I'm here! And you're here! We are both-

boo11.speaker: Kitty
boo11.text: So all of those people at the ghost party are...?

boo12.speaker: Oyen
boo12.text: Dead too, yes. That's why we call it a 'Ghost Party', you know?

boo14.speaker: Oyen
boo14.text: Sometimes we can't change our fate.

boo15.speaker: Oyen
boo15.text: But we can still choose how to face it.

boo16.speaker: Oyen
boo16.text: And you proved again and again how brave you truly are.

boo17.speaker: Kitty
boo17.text: But... What about my mom, my friends? My life?

boo18.speaker: Oyen
boo18.text: You'll always be alive in their hearts.

boo19.speaker: Oyen
boo19.text: And one day, you'll meet them again.

boo20.speaker: Oyen
boo20.text: So it's not a forever goodbye, Kitty!

boo22.speaker: Kitty
boo22.text: What am I supposed to do now?...

boo23.speaker: Oyen
boo23.text: Whatever happens next, we'll face it together.

boo24.speaker: Oyen
boo24.text: Me, John Daniel, Assyla, even Mousie and every other spirit of the forest will always support you!

boo25.speaker: Oyen
boo25.text: You don't have to face it alone, Kitty.

boo1.speaker: Kitty
boo1.text: The doors are too heavy, I need to find an adult to open it for me.
